It is suspected that this event may be related to previous issues with two fixtures on the circuit, which have been replaced for ballast failure in the past month.

Further investigation would be required to confirm this hypothesis, but based on current evidence, circuit 14 appears to have been the point of failure.

Logs show that the inverter output voltage logged minor dips during the test, although it is not ruled out that other factors may have contributed to the failure. The maintenance lead reported that the inverter has been functioning normally prior to this incident, and most likely the fault occurred recently. Further investigation will be required to determine the root cause of the issue.
